decision: Retain orthographic. Promote portrait mobile (aspect <= 0.72) as an authored navigable HOME using the M2-equivalent pose plus bounded pan/recenter; 16:9 remains on the existing canonical framing. Full-city simultaneous visibility is no longer a requirement.

screen_space_breakpoint_v1.decision: Do not promote tighter B/C as one global framing. Retain orthographic/current global framing pending aspect-ratio-aware mobile home-pose proof.
screen_space_breakpoint_v1.key_finding: 16:9 benefits from tighter screen-space; portrait mobile is already crop-limited rather than scale-limited.

adaptive_mobile_home_pose_v1.decision: Aspect-ratio-specific home framing is validated as a useful principle, but no tested mobile pose is promoted. Current runtime home pose remains canonical pending functional-district anchor rebalancing.
adaptive_mobile_home_pose_v1.key_finding: M2 keeps Hero Bastion dominant and reveals Cuartel fully, but Granero remains mostly outside portrait due to horizontal projected anchor spread.

mobile_navigable_city_v1.decision: Home pose is an entry composition into a city larger than the viewport. Do not move Granero/Cuartel or zoom out merely for simultaneous visibility. Camera investigation is closed; return to graphical production.
